name: Kyrios
description: A student of Perisophia who argues that the leonin cub remains a leonin.

timeline.summary: Perisophia opens a lesson in Meletis by asking her students what identity is, using the example of a leonin cub raised by wolves.
timeline.quote: "What is identity? What makes us who we are?"

timeline.summary: Perisophia urges her students to dwell in the mystery rather than hastily answering.
timeline.quote: Dwell in the mystery for a bit and see what arises.

pages_say.description: A student of Perisophia who argues that the leonin cub remains a leonin.
